name: stat-count-up-bars
title: Stat Count-up With Bars
description: A dim label and a giant figure counting up in the main colour with a bold unit under it, then a bar chart whose bars grow while their values count (the last one highlighted), then a percent ring that draws itself with its figure and a few words beside it.
useWhen: A business milestone, a channel's numbers or a data-led lesson with one headline figure, a short trend and one percentage.
Figures that should be read in order: total first, trend second, share last.
avoidWhen: Only one number: use a plain counter block.
More than six data points or exact axes: use a real chart block.
Several milestones as a list: use milestone-counter-list.
author: Mosio

variables.label: Label
variables.description: Dim line above the big number.

variables.label: Big number
variables.description: The number the headline counts up to.

variables.label: Unit
variables.description: Bold line under the big number.

variables.label: Bars

variables.label: Bar value suffix

variables.label: Percent

variables.label: Accent
